note: Real, signed advertisers only. 'slots' are one sponsor line at the top of a board (jobs, deals, events, classifieds); News/All, Police & courts and Obituaries have no ads. 'rails' are the side ads on wide screens, shown only on the Events, Jobs, Deals and Classifieds tabs. Each ad: name, text, url (https only), optional cta. Every ad is labeled 'Sponsored' and links with rel="sponsored". An empty slot or rail shows the site's own 'Advertise with us' unit, which opens the advertising inquiry form.
